phase_name: AAA UI Overhaul — Main Menu + Character Select

remaining_tasks.name: C# gradient texture generation for buttons
C# glow overlay VisualElements for panels
C# depth layering system for AAA panel look
Audio assets (demon laughs, girl crying, music)

blockers.description: USS alone cannot achieve AAA visuals — no gradients, box-shadow, blur filters. Must use C# runtime texture generation + layered VisualElements for premium look.
blockers.workaround: Generate Texture2D gradients at runtime, apply as background-image. Create overlay VisualElements for glow/depth.

blockers.description: HTML mockup used CSS features impossible in UI Toolkit — created expectation gap
blockers.workaround: Next session: build visual effects through C# code, not USS. Reference mockup for DESIGN targets, implement via Unity-native techniques.

decisions.rationale: AAA RPG standard (Diablo/Elden Ring style), doesn't compete with demon figure

decisions.decision: All buttons same size, orange on hover only
decisions.rationale: User preference — no primary/secondary distinction at rest

decisions.decision: SPD renamed to STAMINA, dynamic swap to MANA for casters
decisions.rationale: Physical heroes use STAMINA (green), VOIDTOUCHED/UNCHAINED use MANA (purple)

decisions.decision: D&D attributes as numbers not bars
decisions.rationale: User preferred bold numbers over same-color bars that were hard to differentiate
Speed affects casting/melee/ranged attack speed — universal stat, displayed as number

decisions.decision: Champion 50/50 split in panel, removed from 3D stage
decisions.rationale: Hero gets full spotlight on stage, champion gets prominent info+model area in panel

decisions.decision: Visual effects MUST use C# route, not USS-only
decisions.rationale: USS lacks gradients, box-shadow, blur — proven by terrible visual result from USS-only approach

next_action: Build C# UIGradientHelper that generates Texture2D gradients at runtime and applies them as background-image to buttons and panels. Then create UIGlowOverlay system that adds layered glow VisualElements. Match the V5 mockup (.superpowers/brainstorm/stable/aaa-v5.html) pixel-for-pixel using Unity-native techniques.
context_notes: The USS-only approach failed spectacularly. All 17 USS/UXML tasks are committed and compile clean (0 errors) but look nothing like the approved mockup because UI Toolkit lacks CSS gradients, box-shadow, and filter effects. The STRUCTURAL changes are correct (vertical buttons, stat colors, champion layout, bottom bar alignment) but the VISUAL QUALITY needs a complete C# implementation pass. The mockup is at .superpowers/brainstorm/stable/aaa-v5.html. Bug scan found 4 pre-existing HIGH issues (ButtonVFXHelper callback leak, async void TriggerEmbark, FindAnyObjectByType in hot path, gamepad stick misread) — none introduced by our changes.
